items.title: What Could Go Wrong With Ford Stock?
items.summary: The most concerning figure for a Ford Motor (F) holder is the loss at model e. Management noted on the July 28 call that model e lost $919 million before interest and taxes in fiscal Q2 2026. This loss occurred on revenue of $1 billion, meaning the segment lost nearly as much money as it brought in. Is that loss getting smaller, and how big is it next to what the rest of Ford earns.
